# Log Radar

> A browser-only tool that highlights anomalies in container logs using embeddings — no labels, no supervision, no server.

Log Radar turns each unique log line into an embedding (Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 22M params, quantized q8), computes the frequency-weighted centroid, and scores lines by cosine distance to surface anomalies. Everything runs locally in the browser via Transformers.js.
